name: @aart/dashboard
description: AART dashboard (architecture §13, spec §35): server-rendered v1 read-only pages / v2 writable actions / v3 production views over @aart/server's HTTP API, with every writable action a thin call to the same function CLI/MCP call (architecture §13.2 three-client principle).

scripts.build: pnpm run build:frontend && pnpm run build:backend
